question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH periods AS (
  SELECT column1 AS reporting_period, column2::DATE AS period_start, column3::DATE AS period_end
  FROM VALUES
    ('January–June 2025', '2025-01-01', '2025-07-01'),
    ('July–December 2025', '2025-07-01', '2026-01-01')
), repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT p.reporting_period, o.CUSTOMER_ID
  FROM periods p
  JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE >= p.period_start
   AND o.ORDER_DATE < p.period_end
   AND o.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE
  GROUP BY p.reporting_period, o.CUSTOMER_ID
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT p.reporting_period, COUNT(r.CUSTOMER_ID) AS repeat_customer_count
FROM periods p
LEFT JOIN repeat_customers r ON r.reporting_period = p.reporting_period
GROUP BY p.reporting_period, p.period_start
ORDER BY p.period_start

action.answer: Using repeat status evaluated separately within each half (a customer with at least two delivered orders in that half): January–June 2025 had 94,251 repeat customers; July–December 2025 had 95,899. July–December had 1,648 more repeat customers.
